sources.title: Panthers re-sign Brady Christensen
sources.description: On Friday, the Carolina Panthers announced that they have re-signed do-everything offensive lineman Brady Christensen. The Panthers selected Christensen in the third round of the 2023 NFL Draft. He played tackle in college but has played at all five positions across the offensive line in the NFL.
